Advances: specled.package

From specled_-hj4.2 verification notes N1+N2 (2026-07-25). N1: docs/coverage.md:47 appends the spec.check verdict read-protocol sentence to a paragraph about mix spec.cover.test exit codes, but spec.cover.test never prints a verdict line (print_verdict exists only in spec.check.ex / spec.validate.ex) — relocate to a real spec.check passage or drop the surface; ticket-authoring defect, sentence itself is verbatim-correct. N2: instructions telling adopters to run mix spec.check and look for detector_unavailable silently return nothing because detector_unavailable defaults to :info and filter_for_stdout suppresses info without --verbose/SPECLED_SHOW_INFO=1 — add --verbose at skills/spec-led-bootstrap/SKILL.md:464-467, :135-137, references/detection-matrix.md:130-137, :236-240.

## Spec co-change authorization

Editing .spec/specs/package.spec.md and the tool-managed baseline .spec/realization_hashes.json (via its documented regeneration path) is IN SCOPE when the spec gate demands co-change for the touched doc/skill surfaces.

## Allowed touches

- docs/coverage.md
- skills/spec-led-bootstrap/SKILL.md
- skills/spec-led-bootstrap/references/detection-matrix.md
- .spec/specs/package.spec.md
- .spec/realization_hashes.json

## Out of Scope (files)

- lib/**, test/** — docs-only ticket
- skills/spec-led-bootstrap/references/task-templates.md — specled_-0x4.4 owns it
- docs/adoption.md, docs/concepts.md — already swept by specled_-zhe

## Out of Scope (intent)

- No code changes
- No severity/default-behavior changes — wording and placement fixes only, per N1+N2
- Do not weaken or reword the verdict read-protocol sentence itself (it is verbatim-correct); only relocate it to a passage genuinely about mix spec.check, or drop the misplaced surface

## Verification

- mix spec.check --no-run-commands passes on the stage branch
- The verdict read-protocol sentence no longer sits in a mix spec.cover.test passage in docs/coverage.md; if kept, it sits in a passage about mix spec.check
- All four instruction sites tell adopters to use --verbose (or SPECLED_SHOW_INFO=1) when probing for detector_unavailable: SKILL.md ~:464-467, ~:135-137, references/detection-matrix.md ~:130-137, ~:236-240
